title: Brand Partnership Associate - esports, Gaming & Internet Culture
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .
 52 million Americans own crypto, and they skew younger, more diverse, and more digitally engaged. Coinbase is building the platform for the onchain economy, from crypto trading to tokenized stocks, prediction markets, and beyond. The Brand Partnerships team meets this audience where they already are, partnering with premium sports, gaming, and lifestyle properties to build cultural relevance and shift brand perception through activations that feel unconventional yet native. As a Brand Partnership Associate - esports, Gaming & Internet Culture, you'll own the coordination and operational execution across Coinbase’s gaming and crypto portfolio, including partnerships with Riot Games, Polytopia, and gaming and crypto-native creators, managing timelines, partner deliverables, and activation logistics.
 What you’ll do:
 Develop and maintain relationships with key gaming partners and support the Sr. Manager and cross-functional teams on brand initiatives leveraging the gaming and creator portfolio.
 Own asset inventories, activation trackers, and timeline management for Riot Games, Polytopia, and gaming and crypto-native creator partnerships, and maintain a tracker for emerging pilot opportunities.
 Lead day-to-day project management for gaming activations, including weekly status updates, meeting notes, creative approvals, partner follow-ups, and coordination with external partners…

title: Finance & Strategy Senior Manager
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
 The Brokerage Finance & Strategy team supports the largest P&L at Robinhood. We oversee all financial aspects of Robinhood's core trading and net interest products in Brokerage, including equities, options, margin lending, securities lending, uninvested cash and more across self-directed, managed, and institutional accounts. We also serve as the finance partner to Robinhood's Platforms organizations: Customer Experience, Customer Trust & Safety, Financial Crimes, and Fraud Operations. These volume-driven teams protect our customers and keep the platform running for every business at Robinhood, and their scope reaches well beyond Brokerage.
 As the Finance & Strategy Senior Manager for Platforms, you will be the senior finance lead and primary thought partner to the leaders of these organizations. You will own the end-to-end financial picture for teams whose cost base moves with customer volume, market activity, and product launches: translating contact, case, and alert volumes into headcount and vendor capacity, forecasting fraud and operational losses, setting and defending expense and efficiency targets, and shaping the investment case for automation and tooling. title: Lower Funnel Product Adoption Strategist
location: Chicago, IL; Los Angeles, CA; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 Reddit’s Product Adoption team accelerates adoption of priority advertising products and features in partnership with our Global Sales and Product organizations. We help advertisers achieve their business goals while building durable product usage and revenue growth.
 As a Lower Funnel Product Adoption Strategist, you will turn advertiser and business needs into practical product strategies, adoption programs, and measurable outcomes. You will work across assigned accounts, sales teams, products, and markets.
 Depending on business priorities and your experience, your focus may include Lower Funnel products (including Conversions, Lead Gen, Shopping/Catalog Sales, and App), Reddit Max , Signals implementation (Pixel and CAPI), and other relevant priority product initiatives.
 You will combine product expertise, consultative selling, analytical thinking, and program execution. You will engage directly with advertisers and agencies, equip sales teams to scale adoption, and bring structured market feedback to Reddit’s Product and go-to-market partners.
 MULTIPLE OPENINGS, ONE CORE JD
 This job description supports multiple Product Adoption Strategist openings across various levels. The interview process will help identify the best-fit product specialty, team and market assignment, and level based on candidate strengths and business needs. Strong lower-funnel advertising experience and fluency are required; deep expertise in every listed product or sub-area is not.
